entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, and you've reached VeloFit Customer Support. How can I help you today?
Yeah, hi. I need to return a jersey. Order number is 77-4-B-91.
Okay, 77-4-B-91. Let me pull that up for you right now... I see the Pro-Aero jersey delivered about 78 days ago. Can I ask the reason for the return?
It's the wrong size. I finally tried it on for a long ride and it's just way too tight across the shoulders. I'd like to do an exchange if possible.
I understand. Let me just check the policy for that item. One moment.
Okay, I've confirmed it. Since you received the jersey 78 days ago, you're still well within our 90-day return window. We can absolutely process that for you.
Great. So what's the next step?

I've just emailed a pre-paid return label to the address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off with the carrier. Once we get it back, we can send out the correct size for your exchange or process a full refund, whichever you prefer.
Got the email. Looks good. Thanks for the help.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
